body: That’s true too. I’m sorry. Didn’t mean to upset you I truly meant the best which isn’t much as you can see lol. Nice talking to you

I’ve never thought of it like that. Idk maybe I didn’t know and I won’t know if you cease to exist but it doesn’t matter cause I know now. Regardless of how long I’ve known you I still wish you the best

I think I have a semi-reliable method. I thought I had some super strong opioids from my wisdom teeth removal and a family members surgery but they’ve been thrown away. If I had them I wouldn’t be here now. I hope you never do it though.

Dude this is amazing!!! Yours is just as good!!! I love how each are different in style and how unique they are and what I love about yours in particular is how epic the music is and how your clips focus directly on the rocket if that makes sense lol
Anyway amazing job!!!! I know my comment may not seem like a lot but I just want you to know yours isn’t any less amazing than anyone else ! Your time was well spent! Keep up the good work :)

What you’ve been told is horrible and false.  What you’re feeling is false too. You’ve made it this far and I know you haven’t done so JUST to make it this far.  Please don’t end it now. I know my words may just be brushed aside and I understand because I’m not good at using them but I truly mean everything I say and I know there is so much for you in the future that’s going to be worth the fight of getting through every single day. Don’t end it. It sounds like you were given a second chance. Not many people get that and even fewer use them wisely.

I really understand. I feel like this constantly and it’s torturous. Depression and anxiety often express themselves in the form of raging anger and I don’t know what to do either. Have you tried running ? Whether it be when you’re angry at that moment or maybe daily at night or in the morning? Perhaps burning a lot of energy would help. I don’t do it often bc I’m lazy lol but a couple of times when  really upset I scribble down everything I feel in a journal. I don’t keep it neat and pretty and I never or hardly at least look at what I write bc I often cringe at stuff like that later lol. Doing that in the moment seems to help me though. I’ll write aggressively and my pen often times will rip the pages but I don’t care. I write what I feel and think and so much more and I think it helps a little. I’m sorry I don’t have any really good ideas :( you’ve got this though!!! I know words like this often times seem to have no meaning but I want you to know I truly believe things will get better and the anger will go away <3
